nsa: NSA is the United States cryptologic organization that coordinates and directs highly specialized activities to protect United States information systems and to produce foreign intelligence information.
NSA means the same as National Security Agency.
nsaid: NSAID is an anti-inflammatory drug that does not contain steroids.
For example: "NSAIDs inhibit the activity of both Cox-1 and Cox-2 enzymes."
NSAID means the same as nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug.
nsc: NSC is a committee in the executive branch of government that advises the president on foreign and military and national security.
NSC means the same as National Security Council.
nsf: NSF is an independent agency of the federal government responsible for the promotion of progress in science and engineering by supporting programs in research and education.
NSF means the same as National Science Foundation.
nsu: NSU is inflammation of the urethra of unknown cause.
NSU means the same as nonspecific urethritis.
nsw: NSW is the agency that provides units to conduct unconventional and counter-guerilla warfare.
NSW means the same as Naval Special Warfare.
nswc: NSWC is the agency that provides scientific and engineering and technical support for all aspects of surface warfare.
NSWC means the same as Naval Surface Warfare Center.
